correctness.rationale: Active contact points of the minimal enclosing ball of C=A∩B have convex weights with zero mean displacement; averaging squared distances bounds each larger ball center offset by sqrt(a²-r²) and sqrt(b²-r²). Triangle inequality for centers and concavity of sqrt(t²-r²) yield D<=2sqrt(s²-r²). The enclosing two-ball radius max(a,b,(a+b+D)/2) is bounded by s+sqrt(s²-r²), since max(a,b)<=2s-r<=s+sqrt(s²-r²). Cauchy–Schwarz gives ratio <=(1+sqrt2)/2. A=(-1,0),(1,0),(0,1+sqrt2), B=(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1-sqrt2) attain equality with radii sqrt2,sqrt2,1,1+sqrt2. The zero-radius and 1D interval cases are explicitly covered; finite sampled balls do not replace proof.
